recorded: 2 October 2026, after inspecting control lineages as the partition permits and before any small- or large-selected outcome value was decoded
control_inspection_findings: Control growth curves peak by days 3-5 and then hold; plate-to-plate SD of per-well maxima 0.093 log units; replete between-lineage SD 0.20; control history deficits relative to replete K: N-Deplete -0.04, P-Deplete +0.31. Control CellsUL is an exact function of BiovolUL; sqrt(BiovolUL) is exactly linear in OD_BC_man for controls. In the 72 h media assay, P-free and full-media controls were still growing at 72 h.
question: With every lineage regrown in one shared medium, does carrying capacity follow a single size law, log K = a + (1 - d) log V, as the budget closure N_cells q(V) = R with q proportional to V^d implies, so that a law fitted on two selection treatments predicts the third, held-out treatment? After a week of N or P deprivation, does regrowth in the same medium restore each lineage's replete carrying capacity?
experiment: Malerba et al. Fig. 3 assay ('All raw data.RData'): 30 lineages x 3 pre-trial histories (Replete, N-Deplete, P-Deplete), regrown for 12 days in standard F/2; 3 replicate wells on separate plates; daily OD at 750 nm. The 72 h media assay is not used: two of its four media do not reach a plateau.

outcomes.primary: log BiovolUL: the authors' calibrated total biovolume per microlitre, square-root linear in manually blank-corrected OD, calibrated on cultures separate from the experiment
outcomes.sensitivity: log OD_BC_man: the common optical scale without treatment-specific calibration; nonpositive values are missing
outcomes.excluded: CellsUL, an exact function of BiovolUL through a treatment-specific calibration

carrying_capacity_estimator: For each lineage and history: on each day, the mean of the log outcome over replicate wells with a finite positive value (at least 2 wells); K is the maximum of these daily means over days 0-11.
size_coordinate: Natural log of the lineage's mean microscopy cell volume (cubic micrometres; prolate spheroid; at least 200 cells) under the same pre-trial history. A lineage-history without a size summary is excluded from every model in that comparison and reported.
folds: As declared in the partition: A develops on Small and Control and evaluates Large; B develops on Control and Large and evaluates Small. Every fit receives only its fold's development lineages.

models.size_law: OLS log K = a + b log V on development lineages
models.constant_biovolume: d = 1: log K equals the development mean (equal biovolume at every size)
models.constant_cells: d = 0: slope 1 with the development-mean intercept (equal cell number at every size)
models.assigned_carbon_cost: Cross-taxon assigned exponent: slope 1 - 2.737/3, from the archived Synechococcus pooled carbon cost degree in diameter, with the development-mean intercept
models.assigned_nitrogen_cost: Cross-taxon assigned exponent: slope 1 - 2.391/3, from the archived Synechococcus pooled nitrogen cost degree, with the development-mean intercept

models.full_restoration: K equals the same lineage's observed replete K (a declared input from the held-out lineage)
models.history_offset: The lineage's replete K plus the development mean of (history K - replete K)
models.size_law_history: OLS log K = a + b log V within the history on development lineages, using history-specific volumes
models.constant_history: The development mean of K within the history

scores: Mean absolute log error over held-out lineage units, per fold; E2 pools both deprived histories with equal weight per lineage-history unit. All models in a comparison score the same units.

decision_rule.pairwise: Model A outperforms model B when its mean absolute log error is at least 0.05 lower in both folds and A has the lower absolute error for a strict majority of scored held-out units in each fold. The converse defines B outperforming A; otherwise the pair is not distinguished. These are descriptive verdicts, not significance tests.

diagnostics: Development-fitted slopes b, implied cost dimensions d = 1 - b, per fold and history; their agreement across folds describes whether one power law spans the 10-fold size range. The OD sensitivity reruns every endpoint with the same rules.
excluded_claims: logarithmic neutrality across coexisting size classes: the lineages grew separately
a measured nutrient quota: none is in the archive
the binding resource at carrying capacity: it was not measured
statistical_scope: Point errors over 10 held-out lineages per fold; no intervals or significance claims
